name: scan-target
title: Scan Target (nmap)
description: Executa um scan de rede (nmap) no host target. Varredura TCP SYN, UDP, Connect.

steps.action: Call MCP tool 'scanShallow' (target='192.168.1.100', ports='22,80,443') to find open ports.
steps.expected_output: List of open ports (host: '192.168.1.100', ports: [22,80,443], services: [ssh, http, https]).

steps.action: Call MCP tool 'scanDeep' (target='192.168.1.100', ports='1-65535') for full scan.
steps.expected_output: Full list of open ports (host: '192.168.1.100', ports: [...], services: [...]).
steps.next: Report: 'Host 192.168.1.100 has X open ports, Y services.'

error_handling: If 'error.code=404': report 'nmap binary not found (install: brew install nmap or apt install nmap).'
If 'error.code=403': report 'Permission denied (root privileges required for raw socket).'
